governance.voting_structure: Une seule categorie d'actions ordinaires, une action egale une voix. Conseil de 9 administrateurs elus pour des mandats d'un an, dont 6 declares independants. Postes separes de President executif du conseil (Scott D. Farmer) et de Directeur general (Todd M. Schneider), avec un administrateur principal (Lead Director).

citations.quote: Todd M. Schneider ... 2025 ... 9,249,676 (Total column, Fiscal 2025 Summary Compensation Table)
In 2024, our shareholders approved, on an advisory basis, the compensation of our NEOs with a FOR vote of approximately 96% of the votes cast.
Each share is entitled to one vote ... All directors are elected for one-year terms ... two separate individuals serve in the capacities of Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.
